 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Ty Jerome averaged 41.2 points and 11.9 assists per 100 possessions — no, seriously — while shooting 42.2 percent from 3. His 25.6 PER would have ranked him seventh in the league if he'd played enough minutes. Those numbers could also make him an in-season trade candidate for a rebuilding Grizzlies team, but first things first. "If healthy" is doing a lot of work here, but if Jerome and Zach Edey stay healthy, the Grizzlies could be shockingly frisky.
